title: ROB project background, chronology and source index
purpose: An experimental tracked humanoid used for robotics education, human-robot interaction and supervised manipulation research.
chronology_method: The 2017-2025 archive chronology is summarized from the project's preserved-archive reconstruction. Original pre-v5 archives remain local; they are not public clone targets. This publication did not re-run historical software or perform a new physical test.

chronology.claim: ROB-specific Mac serial-control work survives in the pre-Git v1 archive.
chronology.evidence_class: Project archive reconstruction; dated source headers and fingerprints

chronology.claim: Earliest surviving Cerebro Git root in the v2 archive.
chronology.evidence_class: Project archive reconstruction; historical Git object

chronology.claim: Preserved histories record speech and perception experiments, controller arbitration, Apple-silicon migration and early language-model integration.
Public galleries document multiple ROB builds and Maker Faire appearances.
Fresh v5 public repository imports an existing application; this is not the start of ROB or Cerebro.
chronology.evidence_class: Public Git root and commit subject

chronology.claim: Supervised can-handling videos document ROB gripping, holding and turning with a can.
chronology.evidence_class: Published historical video and stills; not a continuous autonomous benchmark

chronology.claim: The controller white-paper series records a motion-transition investigation, compatibility audit and recovery-first takeover plan.
chronology.evidence_class: Dated source and test records; physical replacement commissioning remains open

public_source_index.role: macOS coordination, perception, dialogue, authorization and robot I/O; isolated C++ continuous-arm owner and codec
iPhone/iPad operator console and Watch relay; command, maps, telemetry and explicit action approval
SwiftUI visionOS cockpit, authenticated control, video and time-limited arm authority
Arduino Base firmware for low-level drive and serial protocol; historical Head/Torso sketches are separate
public_source_index.inspection_note: Reading path from the project source map; firmware was not flashed or re-tested for this revision.

public_source_index.role: Lidar acquisition, maps and bounded scan publication to Cerebro
Captured Ubuntu host material and recovery tooling; archived vendor core executables are binaries, not recovered source

implementation_boundary: The overview describes project roles and intended capabilities. It does not assert that every capability is active in one session or that the replacement controller has completed physical commissioning.
reuse_note: Repository visibility is not a blanket redistribution license. Consult each repository and third-party component notices.
